description: This file defines the GhostServiceManager class, which manages the lifecycle, configuration, and integration of ghosting/autocomplete features within a VSCode extension. It handles singleton instantiation, resource management, provider registration, snooze functionality, and UI updates.

classes.name: GhostServiceManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing ghosting and autocomplete features, including provider registration, snooze functionality, status updates, and resource cleanup within a VSCode extension.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GhostServiceManager.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes settings, reloads models, registers providers, and updates context and UI.

methods.name: updateInlineCompletionProviderRegistration
methods.description: Registers or disposes the inline completion provider based on settings.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables auto-trigger and related features, updates settings, and reloads.

methods.name: isSnoozed
methods.description: Checks if the autocomplete is currently snoozed based on snoozeUntil timestamp.

methods.name: getSnoozeRemainingSeconds
methods.description: Returns remaining snooze time in seconds.

methods.name: snooze
methods.description: Snoozes autocomplete for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: unsnooze
methods.description: Cancels snooze and re-enables autocomplete.

methods.name: setupSnoozeTimerIfNeeded
methods.description: Sets up a timer to auto-unsnooze if currently snoozed.

methods.name: getSnoozeRemainingMs
methods.description: Returns remaining snooze time in milliseconds.

methods.name: codeSuggestion
methods.description: Triggers inline code suggestion and inserts the first completion if available.

methods.name: updateGlobalContext
methods.description: Updates VSCode context for smart inline task keybinding.

methods.name: initializeStatusBar
methods.description: Creates and initializes the status bar component.

methods.name: getCurrentModelName
methods.description: Retrieves the current model name if loaded.

methods.name: getCurrentProviderName
methods.description: Retrieves the current provider display name if loaded.

methods.name: hasNoUsableProvider
methods.description: Checks if there is no usable provider due to invalid credentials or profile issues.

methods.name: updateCostTracking
methods.description: Updates session cost and completion count, then refreshes status bar.

methods.name: updateStatusBar
methods.description: Updates the status bar with current session info.

methods.name: showIncompatibilityExtensionPopup
methods.description: Displays a popup for extension incompatibility and offers options to disable certain features.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, disposes components, and resets singleton instance.

methods.name: _resetInstance
methods.description: Resets the singleton instance (for testing).
